title: Rockstar Games Union Vote Scheduled During GTA6 Release Window
description: Rockstar Games employees have locked in a union vote scheduled during the GTA6 release window. Success would make it the UK's largest recognized gaming union.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Rockstar Games Employees Lock In Union Vote Date

A date has officially been locked in for Rockstar Games employees to vote on whether to formally recognise their developer union, according to reports from Eurogamer. Significantly, this crucial vote is set to take place over the upcoming release window of Grand Theft Auto 6.

### A Milestone for the UK Games Industry

Should the vote prove successful, the newly recognised body will officially become the largest recognised union across the entirety of the UK video games industry. Given the massive scale of the studio and the intense global anticipation surrounding GTA6, this development places a unique spotlight on the working conditions and internal dynamics at one of gaming's most secretive and prestigious developers.

While the studio continues to press forward with its major project timelines, the outcome of this union vote could set a powerful precedent for labor representation and employee advocacy within the high-stakes AAA video game development sector.

### Editor's Take

Timing a major union vote directly over the GTA6 release window is a bold and significant move for Rockstar Games employees. It highlights ongoing discussions about labor rights in major studios, and its outcome could permanently reshape the landscape of the UK gaming industry.
